name: seo-topic-planner
description: Decide which SEO content opportunities are worth pursuing, with visible cost controls and traceable evidence.

interface.longDescription: Turns a website and brand brief into a typed brand entity registry, ranked evidence-backed SEO content opportunities with information-gain and readiness judgements, and an evidence-backed content plan once the SERP and relevant sources are researched.
defaultPrompt: Help me identify the next SEO content opportunities for my website.
Estimate the research cost before researching our target topic.
Turn my chosen SEO opportunity into a funnel-staged content cluster.
